gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.68725 35.778228)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1000 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-106.68725, 35.778228), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
high_elevation_areas AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Buffer(poi_geom.geom, 100000, 'quad_segs=8'))
),
elevation_raster_clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(high_elevation_areas.rast, true, ST_Buffer(poi_geom.geom, 100000, 'quad_segs=8')) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_areas, poi_geom
),
nearest_high_elevation_point AS (
  SELECT ST_AsText(ST_ClosestPoint(
    ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(elevation_raster_clipped.rast), 4326),
    poi_geom.geom
  )) AS nearest_point_wkt
  FROM elevation_raster_clipped, poi_geom
)
SELECT ST_Distance(
  poi_geom.geom,
  ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText(nearest_point_wkt), 4326)::geography
) AS distance_meters
FROM poi_geom, nearest_high_elevation_point;
